meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 核对本机 Codex 与 LazyCodex 安装是否健康且与最新版一致
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用 Codex 开发,最近一次安装、升级或改配置后遇到了奇怪问题
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Codex and hit odd behavior after an install, update, or config change

howto.what: 触发后,它对照最新源码审计本机 LazyCodex/Codex 安装,输出带证据的“通过/警告/失败”报告;只诊断,不改动你的安装、配置或仓库。
howto.when: 当用户要求做“医生/健康检查”,提到 LazyCodex、Codex 等关键词,或报告装完/更新/改配置后行为异常、怀疑安装过时或损坏、想对照最新源码审计本地安装时触发。

say.text: 给我做一次 LazyCodex 健康检查。
say.note: 会生成带证据的通过/警告/失败报告。

say.text: 我刚更新了 Codex,现在行为很奇怪,帮我诊断一下。
say.note: 会核对版本、配置和插件连接,定位问题。

say.text: 把我的本地装机和最新源码对比一下,看是不是过时了。
say.note: 会同步最新源码,报告版本差距和漂移项。

howto.what_en: When triggered, it audits local LazyCodex/Codex installations against the latest sources and returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence per verdict. Diagnostic only—it does not touch the user's install, config, or repositories during the check.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a doctor/health check, mentions LazyCodex/Codex acting oddly after install/update/config change, suspects a stale/drifted/broken install, or requests an audit against latest sources.

say_en.text: Run a LazyCodex health check on my machine.
say_en.note: Returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence.

say_en.text: I just updated Codex and it's acting weird—please diagnose.
say_en.note: Checks version, config, and plugin wiring to find the cause.

say_en.text: Compare my local install with the latest source to see if it's outdated.
say_en.note: Syncs latest sources and reports version gaps and drift.
